map.根据视星等计算两天体亮度比。公式：F₂/F₁ = 2.512^(m₁−m₂)，即: Compute the brightness ratio of two objects from apparent magnitudes. Formula: F2/F1 = 2.512^(m1 − m2), i.e. the brightness ratio is 2.512 raised to the 'magnitude difference'. Smaller magnitude means brighter, and a difference of 5 magnitudes means a 100-fold brightness difference.
map.根据两颗星的视星等差，计算它们的亮度比 F₂/F₁=2.512^(m₁−m₂)。: From the apparent magnitude difference of two stars, compute their brightness ratio F2/F1 = 2.512^(m1 − m2).
map.直观理解「星等每差 5 等亮度差 100 倍」的 Pogson 标度。: Intuitive grasp of the Pogson scale where 'a 5-magnitude difference means a 100-fold brightness difference'.
map.在观测计划里判断亮星对暗星观测的干扰程度。: Judge how much a bright star interferes with observing a faint one when planning observations.
map.示例：星等差 2.5 等的亮度比: Example: brightness ratio for a magnitude difference of 2.5
: F2/F1 = 2.512^(m1 − m2) = 2.512^2.5 ≈ 10. So at a difference of 2.5 magnitudes the brighter star is about 10 times the fainter one (about 2.512 times per magnitude, and smaller numbers are brighter).
map.为什么星等数字越小越亮？: Why does a smaller magnitude number mean brighter?
map.历史沿用肉眼可见的亮星定为小数值；Pogson 标度规定亮 100 倍对应星等差: Historically, stars visible to the naked eye were assigned small numbers; the Pogson scale sets 100 times brighter to a magnitude difference of 5, so smaller numbers are brighter.
map.2.512 这个底数怎么来的？: Where does the base 2.512 come from?
map.由 100^(1/5)≈2.512 定义，确保星等差 5 恰好对应亮度比 100: Defined by 100^(1/5) ≈ 2.512 so that a magnitude difference of 5 corresponds exactly to a brightness ratio of 100, a convention Pogson fixed in 1856.
